clusters.pick_reason: Both PRs make the identical core change to buildWellKnownPath (regex strip of all trailing slashes), so #2214 is a strict subset. #2215 additionally patches shouldAttemptFallback's root-path check from `pathname === '/'` to `pathname === ''` via a new normalizeDiscoveryPath() helper — a fix #2214 omits. Since the regex-based stripping turns a lone '/' into '' (not '/'), landing #2214 alone leaves shouldAttemptFallback's `pathname === '/'` check dead, causing redundant fallback attempts on root-like paths (the exact bug #2215's title names). #2215 also factors the strip logic into one shared helper instead of duplicating the regex inline in two call sites.

members.title: chore(client): normalize trailing slashes in discovery paths
members.author: raashish1601
members.reason: [llm] duplicates #2215: buildWellKnownPath (and buildDiscoveryUrls) only stripped a single trailing slash via `endsWith('/') + slice(0,-1)`, so pathnames with multiple trailing slashes (e.g. '/foo//') still produced malformed double-slash discovery URLs like '/foo//.well-known/oauth-authorization-server'. Both PRs fix the same root cause with the same technique: replace the single-slash-strip with a `pathname.replace(/\/+$/, '')` regex that strips all trailing slashes.
